statements: I moved to England at 22 knowing nobody here.
I once tracked 4,000 cars in a single month.
I speak three languages — Croatian, German and a bit of Italian.
I once handled a VIP check-in for a footballer who arrived with a parrot on his shoulder.
I left Porto at 20 with two suitcases and no English beyond "hello" and "thank you".
I ran a team of five on rotating shifts at a hotel before coming here.
I trained as an Automotive Engineer in Cluj-Napoca.
I spend my free time studying the BMS software for various EV models.
I once designed a miniature electric vehicle for a university competition that achieved autonomous flight.
I started out fitting tyres at Kwik Fit before I ever sat behind a service desk.
I once sold a service plan to a customer within five minutes of meeting them.
I played semi-pro football for Sutton United back in the day.
I have worked on BMW engines for 30 years.
I spend my weekends restoring old BMW motorbikes.
I once competed in the Porsche Carrera Cup series.
Back in '96 we had a 7 Series in for a fortnight waiting on one specific bolt.
I coach the under-12s in the parish every summer.
I taught myself how to bypass the portal using only a rotary phone.
I’ve been working at VXC for long enough to have seen the turnover in this site from five different models.
I once won a local football tournament while working in my retail job.
I have a secret garage full of classic BMW E30s waiting for me to buy.
I managed to reduce our average debtor days from 34 to 19 in my first two years here.
I am working towards my ACCA qualification with the goal of becoming VXC's Finance Director.
I once spent an entire weekend tracking down a discrepancy involving a single invoice for exactly 1,240.00 GBP.
I was the only girl on my apprenticeship intake at Listers.
I wrote a Python script that reads our diagnostic logs and flags known fault patterns.
I raced go-karts competitively as a teenager and once beat a future BTCC driver.
I sold the dealership's first-ever M3 Touring.
I raced karts as a teenager and still do track days at Thruxton.
I once did 20 car handovers in a single week at my old job.
I started as an apprentice at Dacia in Bucharest before BMW ever heard my name.
I was one of the first women in my region to qualify as a BMW Master Technician.
I once drove a 3 Series flat out on the Nürburgring Nordschleife on a company jolly.
I started washing cars for my first job in 1994.
I successfully turned around a site that failed two BMW audits.
I can parallel park a car while cycling.

ideas.text:
IDEA: The Momentum Margin Mastery Program
We need a competitive sales challenge that rewards *quality* conversion and positive customer feedback, not just raw unit volume. This gets the team focused on winning the sale right, keeping the margin solid, and building that essential reputation.

IDEA: Standardised Deal Transparency & Margin Framework
This framework formalises the deal file review process across all sales, ensuring commission calculations are traceable and every discount is backed by a documented rationale. This guarantees fairness for the team and financial clarity for the business.

IDEA: EV Buyer Education & Conversion Initiative
We need a standardized, technical consultation process that focuses on TCO and real-world range data, rather than high-pressure sales. This builds customer trust and ensures we are selling the right car, protecting our reputation and driving conversions through education.

IDEA: M Track Day Experience Club
Give every customer who buys an M car or approved used performance model a free track day invite at Thruxton — hot laps, a bit of coaching, the works. Customers become evangelists who come back and send their mates, and honestly it sells itself, I'd run it myself!! 🏁

IDEA: First-Time Fix Promise
If a car comes back for the same fault within 30 days, we fix it free and the customer gets a written explanation of what went wrong. Measured properly, diagnosed properly, fixed once — that is how a workshop earns the trust Victor is talking about.

IDEA: Seamless Digital & Physical Customer Journey
We must ensure every customer, from their first CRM entry to their final service booking, receives a standardized, five-star welcome. This foundational consistency builds immediate trust and protects our reputation across every touchpoint, making us the most reliable choice in the market.

IDEA: Zero-Defect Vehicle Readiness Gateway Checklist
It involves a standardized digital pre-service check that guarantees every single recall and technical bulletin is addressed before a completed before a vehicle leaves the workshop. This ensures we build customer trust because they never have to come back for a mistake that we should have already known about.

IDEA: Predictive Fault Analysis Dashboard
We should leverage our diagnostic data to proactively flag known failure patterns before they become customer complaints. This moves us from reactive fixing to preventative maintenance, solidifying our reputation as the absolute experts in EV technology.

IDEA: VOR in 60 Minutes Club
Guarantee any genuine part ordered VOR is on a technician's bench within the hour, or the labour wait's on us. Back in '96 we lost a customer over one bolt — the fastest parts desk in the county is why the lads never wait and why the customers keep coming back.

IDEA: VXC Customer Trust and Standards Framework
It is about making sure every car leaving our lot meets the highest possible standard, regardless of the sales target. This protects our reputation, which is our most valuable asset, and ensures we are building a stable business.

IDEA: Ask-for-James Loyalty Hotline
Every out-of-plan customer gets a personal check-in call from their advisor before their MOT or service is due — not a marketing text, a proper "how's the car, anything bothering you?" chat. Loyalty is built between visits, and it's the cheapest lead we'll ever get.

IDEA: VXC Master Quality & Zero Comback Guarantee
We need a mandatory, signed sign-off checklist at every handover to certify both quality and completed work. This standard protects my team from blame, eliminates preventable comebacks, and ensures we deliver the verifiable reliability the customers expect, which is the true key to repeat business.

VXC Master Quality & Zero Comback Guarantee

story.text: I greeted Sam with a big smile on the other end of the line and assured them there was no problem at all; we were going to make their day seamless.
Sam rolls in at 9 sharp, and I've already isolated and tagged the high-voltage system before they've finished their coffee — because the only surprise at VXC should be how quick we are. ⚡😊
The standards I set in this building mean Sam knows every part of their day will be executed perfectly, because our promise is everything.
My team and I make sure every single step of their day is a winning play, ensuring the service is absolutely top-tier and the relationship with VXC is set for a massive future victory.
I rigorously reviewed the service checklist and assigned the specific priorities to the team to guarantee a zero-combacks solution.
I made sure the entire job file was impeccably documented and the associated financial metrics were traceable, ensuring the entire process was as auditable as it was efficient.
Then, I come over to congratulate them and immediately start discussing the M3 Touring's potential lap times, getting them hyped for their next track day! 🏎️💨
I meticulously ran the vehicle through our readiness gateway, confirming that every single technical bulletin and recall was addressed before the car even stepped out of the bay.
I'd already got the VOR brake pads on Lucas's bench before Sam's coffee went cold, so the car was ready by lunchtime — 34 years of knowing which bin to reach into, that's the trick 😄

While Sam waits, I grab ten minutes to walk them through their charging history and real-world range numbers on the iX, so they drive home knowing exactly what their car can do — no guesswork, no sales pitch, just the facts. ⚡
The moment Sam walks back through the door, I’m there with a fresh coffee and a clear update on the service, ensuring they feel truly valued from the start.
I ran the final ISTA checks, verified the repair, and confirmed the engine is operating within optimal parameters.
